title: Preserve prior architecture output when generation fails
goal: Attempt regeneration without losing existing readable output or source work.
context: The author has an existing complete snapshot and revised project content.
trigger: The author requests a replacement snapshot.
preconditions: The selected scope and any available project or artifact identity are explicitly identified.

interaction.action: Selects the revised model and intended generated-output destination.
Validates the request and reports rejection or the actual generation result.
Inspects the prior output and project content after a reported failure.
Preserves the prior readable output or explains unresolved recovery without claiming success.

expected_outcome: The author can identify actual effects and recover the declared readable output without losing unrelated work.

alternatives.outcome: The request rejects before changing source or prior output.

failures.condition: Rendering fails or generation is interrupted.
failures.outcome: Prior readable output is preserved or recovered under the declared procedure; unresolved partial state remains explicit.
The result uses a coherent captured selection or reports failure, never a mixed-state success.

sources.locator: SCN-085; confirmed as requirement-analysis knowledge by the scoped author assessment, not independent review or executed product proof.
sources.basis: User-requested reusable customer architecture browser; requirement-level author analysis. Current records remain draft; no implemented, published or independently approved behavior is claimed.
